SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

SECTION 2: TEACHING CONTENT

Hello Learner. Welcome to an English program for Grade 4. Today we will learn about Present Continuous Tense . Your radio teacher is Joyce Agik . Welcome to the program.

Hello Learner. Today, we will talk about Present Continuous Tense . Learner, what are you doing right now? What are you doing right now? - Did you say you are sitting down? - Can you say I am sitting down? - Well done Learner. That is Present Continuous Tense . Present continuous tense is used to show an action is still going on at the time of speaking. Present continuous tense is used to show an action is still going on at the time of speaking. Present continuous tense is formed by adding is, are or am to a verb plus i-n-g. Present continuous tense is formed by adding is, are or am to a verb plus i-n-g. Examples in sentences. Number 1. Jack is washing his bicycle. Jack is washing his bicycle. Number two. I am walking to the shop. I am walking to this shop. And number three. The dogs are barking at the man. Welcome to the program. - Hello learner. Welcome to the program. Learner, I want you to listen to these sentences. My name is Cow. I can eat grass. But I cannot eat meat. My name is Cow. Tell me something you cannot eat. - Tell me something you do not have. - Did you say I cannot eat snakes? I do not have money?. Those are good sentences. Learner I want you to write the following sentences in your exercise book. Number one, my name is Goat. My name is not Sheep. My name is Goat. My name is not sheep. - We are dogs. We are not wild animals. We are dogs. We are not wild animals. - I have wings, but I do not have horns. I have wings, but I do not have horns. - I can eat grass, but I cannot eat meat. I can eat grass, but I cannot eat meat.

Learner, look at the sentences you have written. One. My name is Goat. It is positive. My name is not sheep. That sentence is negative. Number two. We are dogs. That is a positive sentence. We are not wild animals. That is a negative sentence. Number three. I have wings. That is positive. But I do not have horns. That is negative. And number four. I can eat grass. Positive. But I cannot eat meat. That one is negative. Learner, look at the sentences you have written and underline the words. Is not . are not . Do not and cannot. Look at the sentences you have written and underline the words. Is not . are not . Do not and cannot. The underlined wordss can be made shorter. For example, number one. Instead of is not we may say isn't . isn't Number two. Instead of are not, we may say aren’t . aren’t . Number three. Instead of do not, we may say don't . don't . And number four, instead of cannot, we may say can't. can't. Learner in the contracted verbs , the letter “O” is removed. And an apostrophe is added. in the contracted verbs , the letter “O” is removed. And an apostrophe is added. Now spell the word isn't. Isn't. - Spell the word isn't. Isn't. The spelling is. I. S. And now spell the word can’t. The spelling is. C. A. N. apostrophe. T. Very good, Learner. Now, write down the contracted forms of the following sentences. I can't sleep today. Number two, I do not have books. The contracted form is. I don't have books. Number three. My name is not Paul. The contracted form is. My name isn't Paul.
